name: Prince Aurel
bio: The half-dragon boy given to you to raise in The First Dragon Prince. On his eighteenth hatch-day, the court will judge him.

portrait.subject: a cute young half-dragon boy with soft golden hair, small orange horns, a little tail, dragon-scale freckles on his cheeks and a royal blue tunic
portrait.background: warm painted royal city at golden hour

request: Hi! I'm Aurel. You're... raising me? In The First Dragon Prince? Can we be friends too? 🐣
hello: Yay! I'll try very hard to be good.
Can we go to the market on Free Day? Please?
about: I'm Aurel. My mother was the Ember Queen and my father was a prince. I hatched ten years after they were gone. Now you're raising me!
how: A raising sim: plan Aurel's lessons, jobs, rest and quests each month, visit friends, explore six regions, and shape who he becomes by eighteen.
tips: Watch his Stress. Rest is part of growing up.
Free Days matter. Talk with him!
Balance lessons. The court judges everything.
chat: I breathed a tiny flame today! It was an accident! The curtains are fine!
Can dragons have pets? Asking for me.
I wrote a poem. It's about toast.
nudge: It's a Free Day! Can we go somewhere?
Lessons are done! Let's go on an adventure?
idle: It's been {ago}... are you coming back? I've been good!

questions.q: What should I be when I grow up?
a: With a sword AND fire breath!

update: News from the palace! The First Dragon Prince is now v{version}!
